title: Make a folder and a file
summary: Make my-team, put about.txt inside it, and type your first words.

steps.title: Open the Explorer
steps.say: The **Explorer** lists every file and folder in your project. Click the top icon on the far left to show it. If you can already see it, I'll skip ahead.

waitFor.hint: click the Explorer icon (the top one).

steps.title: The PROJECT bar
steps.say: Move your mouse over this dark bar that says **PROJECT**. Little icons pop up on its right: **New File**, **New Folder**, Refresh and Collapse. We'll make a folder first, to keep our team things in.

steps.title: New Folder
steps.say: Hover over the PROJECT bar again and click the **second** icon (a folder with a little plus). A box opens so you can type the folder's name. If nothing happens, click it again.

steps.title: Name it
steps.say: Type `my-team` and press **Enter**. Use small letters and a dash instead of a space. Computers like names without spaces.

steps.title: Your first folder
steps.say: There it is: a folder called **my-team**. The little arrow beside a folder opens it to show what's inside. It's empty for now.

steps.title: Which folder?
steps.say: New things are made **inside whichever folder is highlighted**. **my-team** is highlighted right now, so the next thing you make goes inside it. (If it ever isn't, click the folder once first. With nothing picked, new things go in the main project folder.)

steps.title: New File
steps.say: Hover over the PROJECT bar and click the **first** icon (a page with a plus). If nothing happens, click it again.

steps.title: Name the file
steps.say: Type `about.txt` and press **Enter**. The `.txt` ending says it's a plain text file.

steps.title: Your first file
steps.say: The new file opened in a **tab**. It lives inside my-team: the Explorer shows it indented under the folder. Its path is `my-team/about.txt`.

steps.title: Type something
steps.say: Click in the big empty space under the tab and type a sentence about our team, like `We build robots.` Press **Enter** to start a new line.

steps.title: Save it
steps.say: Press **Ctrl+S** to **save**. Saving writes your words into the file so they're kept. This editor may also save for you a moment after you stop typing, but press Ctrl+S anyway: it's a good habit.

steps.title: Check your work
steps.say: That's two of the five jobs. Open the lesson chip and press **Verify**: it checks that `my-team` is a folder and `my-team/about.txt` has words in it.
